name: Fakhr al-Din As'ad Gorgani
bio: Fakhr al-Din As'ad Gorgani (from Gorgan, in northern Iran) was a Persian poet of the mid-eleventh century who served at the Seljuk court. Little else is securely known of his life.

His surviving fame rests on Vis o Ramin, a romance in rhyming couplets composed about 1054 at the request of a Seljuk official in Isfahan, and counted among the earliest extant Persian romances. It is based on an older Parthian-era story. The Persian text is held here as a work.
